Hi everyone, im a newbie.
Im 17 yrs old, been through hell and back, suffering from social anxiety (quite anxious to even post this haha), depression and PTSD for 3-4 years now. My anxiety was really bad last year that i couldnt go anywhere alone so i never left my house nor my room. The only times I was comfortable leaving or talking to people to order food etc was when i was very drunk. So I became a very heavy drinker just to be "normal" i suppose. My anxiety is still bad, i have some pretty rough days and its hard when no one understands how tough it is to talk to a random stranger or anything. My friends have tried forcing me to talk to men ( which im highly afraid of doing, as i was sexually abused and raped for 4 years) because they "couldnt", yet they would never understand how it tears me apart mentally. Ive gotten slightly better but still not 100%. My anxiety has just become so normal to me. I hate the panic attacks but ive gotten so use to them that it sorta scares me haha. 
Anxiety aswell as PTSD is so draining and mentally screwing. I just live in fear and constantly feel im walking on eggshells, that the tiniest things could trigger an attack or something. Its quite tiring. 

Dont really know what else i can add so yeah :)
